question: To whom may this Kaula teaching be given and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: This Kaula teaching may be given to the worthy
It must not be given indiscriminately
The prohibition applies to just anyone
inference: This Kaula teaching should be given only to the worthy and not to just anyone.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy; it should not be given to just anyone.
